title.narrative: START Life Saving equipment for Pakistan (Shanngla Province)

description.narrative: CAFOD, through Trócaire Pakistan and their national partner, Pak Rural Development Programme (PRDP) will distribute life saving shelter in this 45 day emergency response. The PDMA has confirmed that the 5 Union Councils selected for this project are among the 5 worst affected. Houses are badly damaged and many families sleeping in temporary shelters. Due to the high altitude of Shanga and the early onset of winter, temperatures are dropping quickly. During the needs assessment, children, women and older people highlighted winter bedding as a priority. Many families have not only lost their homes but also their belongings and are unable to purchase sufficient winter items. Tents are being provided by the National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) and the Provincial Disaster Management Authority (PDMA). In addition, during focus group discussions (FGDs), men and women highlighted damage to livestock shelters as a priority. The project will provide potentially lifesaving items (winter bedding and mattresses) for 788 families, as well as tarpaulin sheets to provide shelter for livestock. The quality and quantity of winter kits and tarpaulin sheets provided will be in line with cluster guidelines. The distribution process will follow SPHERE standards, whereby beneficiaries will be informed in advance of the distribution date, time and location and appropriate feedback, shelter, water and sanitation facilities, as well as drinking water will be provided.
